comments.value: I see this as a win win for quest users and pc players
that would be cool having a group call as well

idk if this is even technically possible/worth the effort of making, but i love the idea of having a phone app to call my friends inside of vr from outside of vr while im out and about also with the option of videocalling.
Or have a chat feature like resonate. One where you can already send files, images, texts, and voice recordings. Even invites.

Having a phone that lets you message and call friends without them being in the same world would be awesome, and maybe world creators can choose if they let the phone work or not for like games. Would also be a great way to handle your gallery for pictures and to send them to friends.

Being able to do this by sending camera video (not re-rendering the caller’s world on the callee’s side) would be game-changing for allowing mobile users to have access to much larger worlds through their friends “bringing them along” on a call while exploring. Not only does this provide a way to keep cross platform groups together as they move from world-to-world, it also reduces barriers to participation without limiting content quality or scope. This would enhance and encourage social exploration, especially for very large or complex worlds, which is one of the things that sets VRChat above from other platforms.

It would be nice to be able to call or message VRChat friends who are in-game and don't have Discord, in case I'm trying to figure out what trouble they're having joining a lobby, or want to apologize to and coordinate with Quest users I accidentally left behind. I imagine it would be based on the camera, but at a lower resolution, and ideally, other people (who are close enough?) would be able to see and hear the call too, with call audio anchored to the phone.
an amazing idea! crazy to think that even games such as overwatch have some sort of messaging feature through the client side, yet VRC does not have texting capabilities as of yet.

This would be very difficult to code, and most likely extremely laggy as well so probs some kind of texting friends feature as an alternative, cause im lowkey tired of going to social media to text someone, whos in the same game, a message they might not even see.

details: I think it would be really cool to be able to video call your friends across different worlds and have it mute your mic so other people in the world you're in dont hear you talking to them but can see a phone model in your hand.
title: Phone for VR to video call friends
